title: Saw The Wood!
description: Saw the Wood adds a new tool the game - The Saw. The Saw helps the player effortlessly cycle through wood variants without duping, unfair advantage/disadvantage - and provides easy-to-use function making the game slightly efficient to play.
body:
# Saw The Wood

Ever felt like crafting wood in Minecraft takes way too many steps?

**Saw The Wood** is a small quality-of-life mod that makes working with wood a lot easier. Instead of going through multiple crafting recipes just to get the wood shape you need, you can simply use a saw to quickly convert wooden blocks into other wooden variants.

Need planks from logs?  
Need slabs or stairs from planks?

Just use the saw and get the job done instantly.

The goal of this mod is simple: **less crafting table clutter and faster building**. It doesn't add complicated mechanics or new systems — it just makes working with wood smoother and more convenient.

Perfect for builders who go through stacks of wood and don’t want to spend half their time crafting.
